lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns along the mid-to-posterior lateral flank. The clusters transition from larger, more isolated centroids mid-flank to smaller, more densely packed points toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient with high-luminance crests and shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower foreground exhibits a high density of small, irregularly spaced high-luminance blobs, distinct in scale from the primary flank constellation.
